name: html5-game-ui-framework
description: A renderer-agnostic browser game UI framework with no runtime image assets

scripts.build: npm run validate && npm run metrics
scripts.test: node --test harness/tests/*.test.js && npm run validate && npm run playwright && npm run metrics
scripts.capture: node --test harness/tests/*.test.js && npm run validate && GC_CAPTURE=1 npm run playwright && npm run metrics
